edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as the contract owner in the constructor.
tokenFallback relies on msg.sender being the trusted token contract before routing bets.
finishBet uses msg.sender as the settlement target.
ownerkill's onlyOwner check compares msg.sender to owner before destroying the contract.
_finishBet performs an external token transfer to the player after updating state.
ownerTransferZTH calls ZTHTKN.transfer on an owner supplied address.
ownerkill forwards the whole tracked balance through ZTHTKN.transfer.
ownerkill irreversibly selfdestructs the contract.
dumpdivs is callable by anyone and drains the ETH balance to ZethrBankroll.
Constructor approves MAX_INT allowance for the initial bankroll.
ownerSetBankroll revokes and re-grants unlimited token approval.
betIsValid modifier calls calculateProfit which uses unchecked multiplication.
_playerRollDice may settle a previous pending bet via _finishBet.
finishBet delegates settlement, including token transfer, to _finishBet.
_finishBet obtains the dice roll through random.
random delegates to maxRandom.
_finishBet computes the winner profit with calculateProfit.
_finishBet recalculates maxProfit after balance changes.
tokenFallback routes non-bankroll transfers into _playerRollDice.
Bankroll deposits in tokenFallback update maxProfit.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse refreshes maxProfit.
ownerTransferZTH refreshes maxProfit after reducing the balance.
Constructor initializes the max profit percentage through the owner setter.
Constructor initializes minBet through the owner setter.
_finishBet adds or subtracts bet and profit from contractBalance.
tokenFallback credits bankroll deposits into contractBalance.
setMaxProfit writes maxProfit from contractBalance.
calculateProfit reads houseEdge in an unchecked expression.
_playerRollDice writes the packed roll into playerRolls.
_finishBet reads and deletes playerRolls entries during settlement.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse writes the configured percentage.
ownerSetMinBet writes the minimum bet.
ownerPauseGame writes the gamePaused flag.
ownerSetBankroll updates the bankroll address.
ownerChangeOwner transfers ownership.
ownerUpdateContractBalance directly overrides the tracked balance.
_rollUnder parameter flows into the bet validation and stored roll.
TKN struct supplies sender and value to _playerRollDice.
chosenNumber decoded from token data is passed as the bet roll.
target parameter selects which playerRolls entry is settled.
result local determines win or loss in _finishBet.
profit local is added to the bet and forwarded in the token transfer.
_from parameter distinguishes bankroll deposits from player bets.
_value parameter increases contractBalance on deposits.
newContractBalance parameter overwrites contractBalance.
newMaxProfitAsPercent parameter drives maxProfit computation.
amount parameter is subtracted from contractBalance and transferred out.
sendTo parameter is the recipient of the owner token withdrawal.

normalization_plan.reason: _rollUnder is a simple bet argument only consumed by _playerRollDice and can be folded into that core function node.
The temporary TKN struct only carries sender/value into _playerRollDice, so it normalizes into that function.
chosenNumber is a transient decode of the fallback data used solely as the bet number in _playerRollDice.
target only selects the storage slot settled by _finishBet, so it merges into that settlement function.
result is a local scratch value produced and consumed entirely within _finishBet.
profit is a local scratch value whose only effect is the token transfer inside _finishBet.
_from is the decoded payer address used only by tokenFallback routing logic.
_value is the token amount applied only by tokenFallback when crediting the balance.
newContractBalance exists only to overwrite contractBalance in ownerUpdateContractBalance.
newMaxProfitAsPercent exists only to set the percentage in ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
amount is the single withdrawal quantity handled by ownerTransferZTH.
sendTo is the withdrawal recipient handled by ownerTransferZTH.
